(Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __said__ one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __comprising water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a plant cell wall degrading enzyme__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 11 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos harvested at __a developmental stage conducive to viability__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping of the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __a genotypic analysis of their DNA__. 

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __at least partially automated__.
